title: Deep symbolic recordings overflow the C++ stack
author: Claude-JG
description: revision2026c step RG12.49.4 (found in RG12.50.3): a chain x = sin(x*q[1] + c)*q[2] recorded 8000 times (about 32000 nested nodes) crashes Python with a stack overflow in str(); 30000 times already while recording. ToString, Evaluate, Diff and Destroy of the expression tree are recursive; FlatProgram::Build and GetFlatProgramData are not. Make the tree functions iterative or refuse the depth with an error.
releaseNotes: Deep symbolic recordings: recording takes a time linear in the size of the recording at any depth (a chain of 4000 steps 0.013 s instead of 1.0 s) and neither recording, deleting nor printing overflows the stack; the value of a new expression is computed from the recorded values of its operands. Evaluate() and Diff() of an expression deeper than 10000 operations, and flatEvaluation = False, raise a ValueError instead of crashing; exudyn.symbolic.GetDepth gives the depth; SetValue, SetVector, SetMatrix of a named variable raise while CreateSymbolicUserFunction records a function.
